summary: Two controllers (GasAnalysis, Movement) implement all 81 requirements; issues list invented defaults and design choices for review.

issues.title: Constant values are placeholders
issues.raw: thr=5.0, lv=1.0, evadeTime=1, stuckPeriod=3, stuckDist=2.0, outPeriod=2 (clock units). The spec says they are configured at startup but gives no values; small integral values keep the timed model tractable and avoid the CSP-gen ceiling of fractional constants.
issues.fix_directive: Replace with the deployment's configured values if known.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: gs=[] (spec), sts=noGas, ins=0.0, anl=Front, a=Front, l=front, d0=d1=0.0, T=0. Only gs's initial value is specified.

issues.title: Sensor position to Angle mapping and target-chemical detection rule
issues.raw: angle(x) maps 1-based position x to Left, Right, Back, Front cyclically; analysis reports gasD when a sensor reports the target chemical with intensity > 0. Neither rule is given by the spec. Empty readings default to noGas / 0.0 / Front.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm the sensor layout and the presence criterion.

issues.title: Terminal modes carry a tick-triggered self-loop
issues.raw: GasAnalysis reaches CONCLUDED (the spec's final state) and Movement stays in FOUND; both idle on an invented InputEvent.Tick so that no mode is left without an outgoing transition, per java_codegen_rules.txt. The flag/halt actions are on the stop transitions, so the self-loop does not re-emit flag.
issues.fix_directive: None unless the verifiers reject the encoding.

issues.title: Odometer modelled as a sensor sample, not an input event
issues.raw: d0/d1 are sampled from VehicleSensors.odometer() inside the transitions (CD-Evt3 says the subsystem 'samples this distance'); the platform pushes reports via updateOdometer.

issues.title: Intensity is a real; threshold guard is ins >= thr
issues.raw: Intensity is represented as double. goreq is implemented (and used by intensity/location) but the GasDetected guards use the equivalent ins >= THR comparison directly, as complementary named predicates.

issues.title: location() over all chemicals
issues.raw: CD-Fn2/Fn3 take the peak over the whole sequence, not only over sensors reporting the target chemical; implemented as specified.
issues.fix_directive: Clarify whether non-target chemicals should be excluded.
